info.title: API.SH: Otomoto
info.description: The Otomoto API from API.SH: public Otomoto data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A dealer's Otomoto page: business name, title and description, logo, address, district, coordinates, opening hours, registration date, active listing count and categories, plus its listings (30 per page) with price, make, model, version, year, mileage, fuel, attributes and photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-dealer

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

dealer.name: Bawaria Motors Gdańsk - Dealer BMW i Serwis MINI

get.description:
One Otomoto listing with every parameter: price (gross and net), make, model, version, generation, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, drive, body, engine, power, colour, VIN where shown, registration, first registration, condition, damage, equipment by group, description, all photo URLs and, for dealers, the dealer's business details (name, page, website, address, coordinates, opening hours, active listings). A private seller is only marked as such. `latest=1` with the search filters opens the first current result.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: 1: open the first result /otomoto/v1/search returns for the other params.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The vehicle taxonomy of an Otomoto category with live listing counts: every make (or, with `make`, its models and each model's generations), plus every filter the search takes with its label, input type and values with counts (fuel, gearbox, body type, colour, country of origin, equipment and more).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-makes

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make id (bmw, alfa-romeo) to list its models and generations.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Otomoto's market price check for a listing: the low and high end of the market price range for comparable vehicles, the indicator the site shows for the listing's price, and when the evaluation was made.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-price-evaluation

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric listing id (`id` in /otomoto/v1/search results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otomoto.pl listing link instead of the id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cars and other vehicles for sale on Otomoto (Poland) with the site's filters: category, make, model, generation, version, location and radius, year, price, mileage, power, engine size, seats, battery and range, fuel, gearbox, body type, drive, colour, doors, country of origin, condition, seller type, damage, accident-free, VIN shown and other flags, keywords and any other site filter by its own name, plus sort and paging (32 per page). Each result has id, link, title, price and currency, net price, price evaluation, make, model, version, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, engine size, power, city, region, seller type and the dealer (name, page, logo). Private sellers are never named. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make slug as in Otomoto links (bmw, volkswagen, mercedes-benz...).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or region slug as in Otomoto links (warszawa, mazowieckie...).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Fuel types, comma-separated: petrol, diesel, hybrid, plugin-hybrid, electric, petrol-lpg, petrol-cng, hydrogen.

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Body types, comma-separated: sedan, combi, suv, compact, coupe, cabrio, minivan, city-car.

parameters.name: damaged
parameters.description: false: only undamaged; true: only damaged.

parameters.name: has_vin
parameters.description: true: only listings with a VIN.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otomoto.pl search link instead of the filters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listings Otomoto recommends next to a listing, grouped as the site shows them (with what they were matched on and whether they come from the same dealer): id, link, title, price, currency, negotiable flag, make, model, generation, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, power, engine size, body type, city, region, photos and every attribute.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otomoto-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric listing id (`id` in /otomoto/v1/search results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otomoto.pl listing link instead of the id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
